meta.title: Frely CLI — Your AI. On your terms.
meta.description: Frely CLI connects your terminal to remote agents, local MCP tools, and local models. Open source. Install with npm or download a standalone executable.
meta.socialDescription: Remote agents, local tools, and your own models. Connected from one open-source command line.

tools.label: LOCAL TOOLS / MCP
tools.description: Connect a remote MCP client to local files, shell commands, and persistent processes. Approve your device and workspace in the browser, then add the stable MCP URL to your client.
tools.note: Local execution requires your approval. Shell commands run with your OS user’s permissions; the workspace is not a shell sandbox.
agents.label: REMOTE AGENTS / SKILLS
agents.description: Install a published Frely Agent as a local trigger Skill for Codex, Claude Code, Pi, or another supported host. Keep your current model and provider configuration.
agents.note: Replace the placeholders with a published Agent’s manifest URL and distribution ID. Remote Agent use does not require local MCP setup.
models.label: LOCAL MODELS / PROVIDERS
models.description: Connect a running Ollama or another loopback OpenAI-compatible runtime as a personal Frely Provider. Use it through your existing Frely Access Points and API keys.
models.note: Requires a running local model and an empty, active personal Provider slot. Sharing a Provider does not enable local MCP execution.
install.description: Install the CLI, sign in, then choose your workflow.
install.node: The npm package requires Node.js 22 or newer.
source.description: Frely CLI and this page are open source. Explore the code, report an issue, or contribute your next improvement.
